details:
I’m experiencing a reproducible VRChat performance issue that began recently and did not occur during the previous ~5 months of regular use on the same system.

System specs:

CPU: Ryzen 9 9900X

GPU: RTX 5070

RAM: 64 GB

Storage: NVMe SSD

Mode: PCVR and Desktop (issue occurs in both)

Graphics: Always run at maximum settings

Cache limit: 30 GB

Windows Fast Boot: Disabled

Issue description: After approximately 3 or more hours of continuous VRChat runtime, performance begins to degrade:

Opening the in-game menu causes VRChat to freeze for ~10 seconds

FPS drops from a stable ~90 FPS to ~30 FPS average

Freezes repeat every few minutes, especially when interacting with menus

Over time, VRChat becomes unresponsive and must be restarted

Restarting VRChat immediately restores full performance until the issue repeats

This behavior occurs in both PCVR and Desktop mode.

Additional observations:

Clearing cache does not resolve the issue

Cache has always been capped at 30 GB

Prior to this issue, I had never cleared cache and could run long sessions (10–16 hours) without problems

Issue began suddenly and is now consistently reproducible after long sessions

I received an EAC warning and was removed from VRChat once around the time this issue began

What I have already tried:

Clearing VRChat cache (multiple times)

Reinstalling NVIDIA drivers

Performing a clean driver reinstall (DDU)

Restarting VRChat (temporary fix only)

Restarting the PC

Verifying Windows Fast Boot is disabled

Reinstalling affected applications/files after initial instability

Related system behavior:

VRChat-specific long-session freezing persists

Expected behavior: VRChat maintains stable performance over extended play sessions, including repeated menu usage.

Actual behavior: Performance degrades over time, menu usage causes freezing, and FPS steadily drops until VRChat is restarted.
title: Game freezing when menu is used after ~3 hours of use.
